_comment: docs/components/episode-lifecycle.md — the plan_complete close trigger. A debugging task that matches the 'investigate-failure' seed, so ComposeSkill seeds cp1..cpN. The scripted plan_progress drives EVERY seeded checkpoint terminal (marking cp1..cp8 done — ids past the seeded count are ignored). At turn end CompleteEpisode sees plan.all_terminal → closes the episode as complete/plan_complete and dispatches RecordSkillOutcome IMMEDIATELY (no ~idleTTL wait, unlike skill-plan-integration which closes via idle). Second response is plan_progress-only, which ends the turn (no_tool_calls).

message.content: The checkout service throws a NullPointerException on every request since this morning's deploy. Reproduce it, find the root cause, apply the fix, and confirm the reproduction passes.

scripted_model_responses.content: Reproducing the NPE against the failing endpoint.

arguments.query: checkout service NullPointerException stack trace recent deploy

scripted_model_responses.content: Root cause: the deploy dropped an env var the payment client reads at init, so the client is null on first use. Fix: fail fast on the missing var at startup and restore it in the deploy manifest. Reproduction now passes.
